warnings: SEPARATE BUILDING -- grid_source is the toilet block's 00b master (4.50/6.00 m), not the main building's.

Three T2 trusses, one on each named letter row (ค, ข, ก), spanning the 6.00 m between grid lines 1 and 2. D purlins, the E eave member and the F ridge member run perpendicular to them; all three are drawn with span arrows rather than per-location marks, so each is recorded once with grid_ref null.
The dummy grid lines ค'/ข' that the FLOOR framing needed (S-02) do NOT appear in the roof framing -- the roof spans between the three named rows only, so no dummy grid is involved in this view.

Both ends of the roof carry the note 'ระยะตามแบบสถาปัตย์ ไม่มากกว่า 1.00 ม.' (overhang per the architectural drawings, not more than 1.00 m). That is a stated LIMIT, not a dimension -- no overhang value is fixed on this sheet, so none is recorded.

T2 member sizes BACK-FILLED 2026-07-25 from S-08 (หน้า21): box-section truss, chords 100x50x3.2, webs 75x45x3.2, purlins C125x50x20x3.2 @1.00, span 6.00 m with panel points 0.60/1.50/1.50/1.50/1.50/0.60.
E (อะเส) section CONFLICT RESOLVED 2026-07-25 in favour of the lipped channel C150x50x20x3.2 -- confirmed by A-11 (หน้า12) as well as S-03, against S-08's single box-section label.

NORMALIZED_2026-08-02: point-type grid refs were written with a dash (C-1). Schema section 4 reserves the dash for a RANGE only; a point is row+column with no dash (C1), which is what houses 01-05 use throughout.
